query:
UPDATE devices SET
                 seen_at = ?,
                 battery_voltage = COALESCE(?, battery_voltage),
                 battery_percent = COALESCE(?, battery_percent),
                 signal_dbm = COALESCE(?, signal_dbm),
                 firmware_version = COALESCE(?, firmware_version)
             WHERE key_hash = ?
             RETURNING friendly_id
